tagline: Create onboarding and delivery tasks in Asana from new HubSpot deals
metaTitle: HubSpot + Asana Integration: Deals to Onboarding Projects
metaDescription: Hand closed deals to delivery instantly. GAIA builds an Asana onboarding project from each HubSpot deal and logs milestones back. See the setup steps.
intro:
Every closed deal in HubSpot represents a handoff that needs to happen — from sales to customer success, implementation, or delivery. Without automation, that handoff relies on a salesperson remembering to notify the right team, and the delivery team manually creating tasks that should have been generated from the deal data already sitting in the CRM.

GAIA automates the sales-to-delivery handoff so nothing falls through the cracks. When a deal closes, GAIA creates a structured Asana project or task list for the relevant delivery team, pre-populated with customer details from the CRM. As the onboarding progresses, GAIA can log milestone completions back to HubSpot so account managers stay informed without interrupting the delivery team.

This integration is built for SaaS companies, professional services firms, and agencies where closing a deal immediately generates structured delivery work that needs to be tracked in Asana.

useCases.title: Auto-create onboarding projects from closed deals
useCases.description: When a deal reaches Closed Won, GAIA creates a new project from the appropriate onboarding template, pre-fills customer details, assigns the customer success team, and sets deadlines based on contract start date.

useCases.title: Sync deal data to Asana project fields
useCases.description: GAIA maps deal fields, company name, contract value, product purchased, primary contact, to project custom fields so the delivery team has full context without accessing HubSpot.

useCases.title: Log Asana milestone completions in HubSpot
useCases.description: When key onboarding tasks are completed, GAIA logs the milestones as deal activities, keeping account managers informed of onboarding progress directly in their CRM view.

useCases.title: Escalate at-risk onboardings to HubSpot
useCases.description: When an onboarding project is overdue or flagged as at-risk, GAIA creates a task for the account owner to reach out to the client proactively, preventing churn before it happens.

useCases.title: Trigger post-onboarding sequences on completion
useCases.description: When an onboarding project is marked complete, GAIA enrolls the client in a post-onboarding email sequence, initiating the customer success phase without any manual CRM action.

howItWorks.step: Connect HubSpot and Asana to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your HubSpot portal and Asana workspace. Map pipeline stages and deal properties to project templates and task fields.
Configure which deal stages or properties trigger project creation, which template to use for each deal type, and which fields to pre-populate from CRM data.

howItWorks.step: GAIA bridges sales and delivery automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors the CRM for deal stage changes and creates projects immediately, while also reporting milestone progress back to the deal record so both teams work from accurate, shared data.

faqs.question: Can GAIA use different onboarding templates for different HubSpot deal types?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to select project templates based on deal properties such as product line, contract tier, or customer segment, ensuring the right task structure for each engagement.

faqs.question: What happens to the project if a deal is reopened after being closed?
faqs.answer: GAIA can detect deal stage reversals and notify the project team, or optionally pause or archive the project, depending on how your workflow handles deal reversals.

faqs.question: Can sales reps see onboarding progress without an Asana account?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA logs milestone completions as deal activities so account managers see onboarding progress inside the CRM without needing access to the project.
